description: This file defines the SaveCustomFieldController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It handles the pre-render logic for custom field saving and editing in the HRM system, setting up UI components with localized labels and IDs, and interacts with CustomFieldService for data access.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class managing the save and edit operations for custom fields within the PIM plugin, preparing UI components with localized data.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, setting up properties based on whether a custom field ID is present, and localizing labels for screen list and field types.
